turns.tutor:
Some and any come later. First, how to order. You often order food in a cafe, so you know this moment.
Here is one I build: I want cake. I start with "Can I have", add the food, then please: Can I have a piece of cake, please?
Rule: to order politely, say "Can I have ..., please?" or "I'd like ...".
Right: I'd like a cola, please. Wrong: Give me a cola.
Now you. You want an orange juice. Write one polite sentence to order it.
